english.title: Fail to ensure that there was in force reg 17 to 21 arrangements in event of insolvency
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the

(A)_[organiser]_
(B)_[retailer]_
(C)_[organiser and retailer]_

of a contract, namely **(..SPECIFY THE CONTRACT..), failed to ensure that there were in force arrangements as described in

(D)_[regulations 17, 18, 19 or 20 of the Package Travel, Package Holidays and Package Tours Regulations 1992]_
(E)_[regulations 17, 18, 19, 20 or 21 of the Package Travel, Package Holidays and Package Tours Regulations 1992 as you were acting otherwise than in the course of business]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 16(2) and (3) of the Package Travel, Package Holidays and Package Tours Regulations 1992.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.
INDICTMENT: A fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
